name: Certificate/TLS Recon Agent

skills: Inspect certificate identities, validity and observed endpoints
spawn_when: The assigned task requires this specific result: inventory certificate and tls exposure
verification: Certificate associations do not automatically establish asset ownership
Every material completion claim is supported by an observation or artifact.

permissions.default: no capabilities granted by this manifest

field_rules: Source and time for every asset.
